horizon_censoring.EVALUATED_FUTURE_GT_ACTOR_1S_INVALID: valid frozen status; 1.0s unavailable; may contain zero earlier-horizon H1 records if no earlier future truth is valid
horizon_censoring.bootstrap_replicate_zero_denominator_rul: FAIL_CLOSED_NO_REDRAW if any of the 12 required H1 strata has zero denominator

H1.population: frozen H1 RAW/CALIBRATED records with future truth available at the specific horizon; denominator is horizon-specific and fixed by the materialized 9.13 carrier
H1.primary_estimand: Within each bootstrap replicate, compute empirical coverage separately for each arm x codebook x horizon stratum using only sampled scenarios with frozen future-truth support at that horizon; compute absolute error from q=0.95; macro-average equally over the 12 codebook x horizon strata within each arm. Primary delta is macro_error(CALIBRATED) - macro_error(RAW).
H1.question: Does calibrated posterior uncertainty reduce requested-vs-empirical coverage error versus RAW?
secondary_estimands: macro mean physical probe count CALIBRATED - RAW
all 12 stratum-level coverage errors and paired deltas

H2.question: Does proposed C2 reduce critical-event beam miss versus fixed q=0.95?

H3.interpretation_if_no_prefrozen_margin_is: report reliability delta interval plus resource interval; do not invent a post-FORMAL closeness threshold
H3.question: Does proposed C2 retain critical reliability close to fixed q=0.99 while using fewer resources?

H4.primary_estimand: critical miss/outage(proposed_C2) - critical miss/outage(CAL-frozen matched uncertainty-only comparator)
H4.question: At CAL-frozen matched resource/overhead, does proposed C2 reduce critical miss/outage versus uncertainty-only allocation?
H4.required_before_H4_inference: 9.15B must resolve and hash the exact preoutcome CAL matched-resource authority; if unavailable, H4 is NOT_EVALUABLE rather than replaced
H4.selection_rule: closest CAL mean resource/overhead according to frozen preoutcome authority

H5.primary_estimand: aggregate recovery violation rate - aggregate baseline violation rate, with scenario as cluster and H5 raw per-scene counts re-aggregated in each replicate
H5.question: Does recovery-aware ADB reduce modeled late-conflict/violation probability for FAST, NOMINAL and SLOW versus both frozen baselines?

H6.glare_risk_exposure: report paired delta and CI; no new post-FORMAL threshold
H6.question: Are any H5 gains accompanied by acceptable overmask, VRU visibility and retained illumination rather than uncontrolled side effects?

C3.disposition: do not make a FORMAL C3 runtime claim unless an already-frozen timing carrier is found and hash-bound before analysis
